rows.label: Source-qualified event identity and reference
rows.definition: An event key qualified by its creating component and event time, with an optional reference to an existing event.

rows.label: Event occurrence time
rows.definition: The occurrence instant carried by an Event.
rows.boundary: Not Header transmission time, processing time or an inferred original resultTime.

rows.label: Event creation category
rows.definition: The coded reason for creating an Event.
display: Event.type: Event Type · required/default wording retained
rows.boundary: Required marking and the stated Other default coexist in the source; no encoding omission rule is assumed.

rows.label: Detector property context at event occurrence
rows.definition: Detector-property values at event occurrence, when different from the last Status.
display: Detector property context at event occurrence
rows.boundary: Not every device property, a new sensor, or a guaranteed complete event-time state snapshot.

rows.label: Reported value and associated uncertainty
rows.definition: A reported value and its optional error, preserving the native scalar type, quantity, units and stated uncertainty convention for each structure.
display: ≈ Measured… / Count / Humidity / UTC · value + optional error; per-type conventions
rows.boundary: Most Measured types explicitly require a plus/minus one-standard-deviation error convention. Count, Humidity, UTC and Measured Psecpm3 do not state that convention. Missing error is not zero or exactness; no conversion or normal-distribution assumption.

rows.label: Video-frame detection details
rows.definition: A detection in an image frame, including its pixel bounding rectangle, optional 0–1 confidence and optional track association.
display: Video Detection + Bounding Box [accepted] · pixels, confidence, selection, label, track
rows.boundary: Pixel coordinates are not geographic coordinates. Selection for slewing is not executed motion; suggested labels are not a closed enumeration.

rows.label: Video-derived entity track reference
rows.definition: A detected-entity identifier supplied by video analytics with an optional geographic position.
display: Video Track [accepted] · BSO ID + optional geographic location
rows.boundary: Not a temporal track history, component identifier or guaranteed geographic position for every detection.

rows.label: Declared component capability catalogue
rows.definition: Supported property, command, observable and custom-type declarations.
rows.boundary: Not current values, readiness, execution, or mandatory support for every catalogue item.

rows.label: Declared property definition
rows.definition: Named property contract with typing, structure and optional validity/publication rules.
display: Property Declaration: name, description, type, mutability, structure; range / threshold [0-1]
rows.boundary: Not a reported value, write permission for a particular caller, or current ready state.

rows.label: Declared observable definition
rows.definition: Observable contract; declared observables need not occur in every Event.
display: Observable Declaration: name, description, type, structure; range [0-1]
rows.boundary: The source says reported observables should be declared; do not strengthen should into shall.

rows.label: Declared command interface
rows.definition: Supported command identity with parameter and result declarations.
rows.boundary: Not an issued request, completed operation, or proof of runtime availability.

rows.label: Declared command parameter
rows.definition: Input parameter definition, including required optionality metadata and possible value restrictions.
display: Parameter Declaration: name, description, type, optional, structure; range:Range Declaration [0-1]
rows.boundary: An optional argument is distinct from optionality of its declaration metadata.

rows.label: Declared command result
rows.definition: Expected Response value definition, including optionality and native range type.
display: Result Declaration: name, description, type, structure, optional; range:Range [0-1]
rows.boundary: Do not silently replace Range with Range Declaration or claim a result has actually been produced.

rows.label: Declared custom data structure
rows.definition: Named custom structure, purpose and field definitions.
rows.boundary: Not an untyped arbitrary payload, a registry policy, or an automatically approved domain-model class.

rows.label: Declared field within a custom structure
rows.definition: Field meaning, typing, structure and omission metadata for a custom structure.
display: Field Declaration.name / description / type / structure / optional
Declared field within a custom structure
rows.boundary: Preserve required optional:Boolean plus printed FALSE default without inventing wire omission rules.

rows.label: Declared built-in or custom value type
rows.definition: Distinguishes native built-in datatype codes from previously defined custom types.
display: Type → Type Name | Custom Type Name
Declared built-in or custom value type
rows.boundary: Type Name membership alone does not establish implementation support; descriptive typos do not create aliases.

rows.label: Declared value shape and collection bounds
rows.definition: Single-value versus multi-value structure; list/array length and tree depth bounds stay separate.
display: Structure → Single | List | Associative Array | Tree; min/max length or depth
Declared value shape and collection bounds
rows.boundary: No absent maximum becomes zero; no-field Single Structure does not mean a null value; a data tree is not hardware composition.

rows.label: Declared permitted or excluded values
rows.definition: Value restrictions with explicit endpoint inclusion or individual-value inclusion/exclusion.
display: Range Declaration.ranges [0+] → Bounded Range | Discrete Range
rows.boundary: Not sensing reach, operating thresholds, measurements, or invented precedence among overlapping restrictions.

rows.label: Declared property mutability
rows.definition: Describes whether/how a property is modifiable, distinct from runtime state.
display: Property Declaration.mutability → PERMANENT | READ ONLY | READ WRITE | WRITE ONLY
rows.boundary: Not caller authorization, ready/reporting state, or proof of modification; retain the native WRITE ONLY wording.

rows.label: Absolute-value publication threshold
rows.definition: Explicit comparison value for a publication-trigger condition.
rows.boundary: Not a validity limit, quality assessment, detected threat, or proof that a trigger fired.

rows.label: Relative-change publication threshold and reference basis
rows.definition: Change-based comparison using last measured, last reported, or component-uptime values.
display: Relative-change publication threshold and reference basis
rows.boundary: Not an absolute limit or physical lifetime history; current reading and last reported value are not interchangeable.

rows.label: Declared property publication triggers
rows.definition: Collection of absolute/relative conditions for Status publication regardless of status interval.
rows.boundary: Not command execution, validation failure, or an invented Boolean combination/trigger algorithm.

rows.label: Supported operating mode
rows.definition: An option a device supports isn't necessarily the one in use.

rows.label: Declared default mode
rows.definition: Don't promote a printed default to current effective state.

rows.label: Source-reported operating mode
rows.definition: Keep source report time and subject; don't infer live state.

rows.label: Message priority
rows.definition: Relative importance of an exchanged message.
rows.boundary: Not measurement quality, confidence or an equipment safety classification.

rows.label: Message-data validity expiry
rows.definition: The instant after which the contained data should be treated as invalid.
display: Administrative / Config / Event / Registration / Request / Response / Status.stale [0-1]
rows.boundary: Not guaranteed deletion, archive/query accessibility expiry or automatic observation result time.

rows.label: Exchange sender and intended recipients
rows.definition: The sender and one or more intended recipients of an exchange.
rows.boundary: Distinct from the original author of each message, the detector, or a cryptographically authenticated principal.

rows.label: Exchange transmission time
rows.definition: The time the exchange was sent.
rows.boundary: Not event occurrence, original measurement production, reception time or Bennett resultTime.

rows.label: Administrative network and service notification
rows.definition: A notification code identifying an occurrence affecting the named components.
rows.boundary: Not a performed sensing observation; no extra Alarm ID field is introduced.

rows.label: Message author or registration announcer
rows.definition: The source role declared by each message: usually original author, with the specified Registration and Response exceptions.
display: Administrative.source / Config.source / Event.source / Registration.source / Request.source / Response.source / Status.source · roles qualified
rows.boundary: Not automatically Header.from, the observed object, the hardware sensor or verified issuer identity.

rows.label: Source-message reference for provenance
rows.definition: Reference to an existing message for pedigree, preserving the original author, conversation-scoped identifier, type and time.
display: Message Reference · originator, identifier, message type, time
rows.boundary: Not an Event Reference, proof of authentic authorship, a new observation or an automatic equality with Request.request id.

rows.label: Named value payload
rows.definition: A named value whose actual type must be defined in the data model and interpreted through its containing context.
display: Name Value Pair · name + Wildcard value
rows.boundary: No standalone type field is invented in Name Value Pair; a named value is not automatically a physical transducer or a performed observation.

rows.label: Named-value associative collection
rows.definition: An empty-capable collection of named values, with value types supplied by the associated declaration.
display: Associative Array · values: Name Value Pair [0+]
rows.boundary: Not a hardware hierarchy or a guessed JSON-object encoding; declaration and instance remain distinct.

rows.label: Declared-type value list
rows.definition: An empty-capable list of values whose type is defined by the associated Property, Parameter or Observable Declaration.
rows.boundary: Not a list of component children and not a substitute for List Structure declaration bounds.

rows.label: Custom-structure field values
rows.definition: Instance fields used to send a custom type over the wire.
display: Custom Type · fields: Name Value Pair [0+]
rows.boundary: Not Custom Type Declaration or proof that an extension is a core standard type.

rows.label: Recursive same-type value hierarchy
rows.definition: A recursive information hierarchy with a named value at each node and an empty-capable child list; all nodes have the same datatype.
display: Tree · value + children; same node datatype
rows.boundary: Not physical composition, containment or a platform hierarchy. Required children with None omission prose is retained for encoding reconciliation.
